Rounded prompt bubble corners no longer leave a gap between lines.

- The corner images of a multi-line prompt bubble fill their cell exactly in terminals that fit images by keeping their aspect ratio (Ghostty), on both 1.5x and 2x screens, so the bubble's edge no longer breaks at its corner rows

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
